{{Quote|Incoming droid starfighters. Steel yourself for an attack!|Qui-Gon Jinn bracing the Wookiees for an attack by SRAM-13's droid starfighters|audio=IncomingFighters.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
'''SRAM-13''' was an individual who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], SRAM-13 [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the company's main [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. The base was targeted by the Trade Federation's rival [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], during which SRAM-13 sent multiple groups of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to attack and [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the nearby Wookiee [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]]. The battle resulted in the expulsion of Trade Federation forces from Alaris Prime by the Wookiees.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They appear to be scouting. They will certainly return for an attack shortly.|Qui-Gon Jinn, describing the surveillance conducted by SRAM-13's droid starfighters|audio=TheyWereScouting-converted.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Trade_Federation_base.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The base SRAM-13 commanded]]
SRAM-13 was an individual who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. During the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] fought between the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|rightful]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]]<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], which involved SRAM-13 as depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> SRAM-13 [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] the Trade Federation's primary [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]] on the moon, which contained a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. SRAM-13 also commanded the base's associated [[Droid/Legends|droid]] units, which included [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], aircraft, [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]], and [[utility trawler]]s which gathered [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the nearby [[Water/Legends|river]]. Near the end of the war, the Wookiees established a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|settlement]] south of the Trade Federation base, with several [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] outside its walls to alert them of Trade Federation movements.<ref name="GB" />

SRAM-13 made the first strike against the Wookiees in what became the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], sending a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] force of five [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]] and a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] to attack the sentry posts. SRAM-13 also dispatched a trio of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|light droid starfighters]] to [[Scout/Legends|scout]] the Wookiee base, prompting the Wookiees' [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], to recommend that they build up their own [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] defenses.<ref name="GB" /> Eventually, the Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] built up a fighting force to assault the base, destroying its [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] with [[Blade bomber|Heavy Blade]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] and [[Death/Legends|destroying]] the droids there.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> SRAM-13 lost the battle when the Wookiees destroyed the fortress<ref name="GB" /> with [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]],<ref name="Prima" /> expelling the Trade Federation presence from Alaris Prime.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well, he lived at my desk at LEC and people used to actually come by to point, laugh, and in some cases leave offerings to him. So I tried to include him in every game I worked on.|Lily Mansfield, explaining the origins of Santaram, who was referenced in SRAM-13's name|<ref name="Discussion">{{DMCite|dm=File:LilyMansfield-Santaram2-Twitter.png|creator=[[Lily Mansfield]]|date=2022-01-03}}</ref>}}
[[File:LilyMansfield-Santaram-Twitter.png|thumb|right|150px|Santaram, the namesake of SRAM-13]]
SRAM-13 was mentioned in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', in which the individual was named as the leader of the Trade Federation forces in the seventh level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "The Battle for Alaris Prime." In contrast to the other levels of the tutorial which only have a single enemy team, SRAM-13 commands two allied teams. One team only has SRAM-13's name and represents the base, workers, and air units, while the other is named "SRAM-13 ground units" and contains the droideka and beetle droids.<ref name="GB" />

SRAM-13's name was chosen as an abbreviation of "Santaram," a ceramic statue of a goat with [[Santa Claus/Legends|Santa Claus's]] head, which was owned by ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' level designer [[Lily Mansfield|Brandy "Lily" Childs]], now named Lily Mansfield. She kept the statue on her desk at LucasArts where it became an inside joke with other staff members, and attempted to reference it in every project she worked on.<ref name="Discussion" /> In one such example, Mansfield believed that a texture artist had hidden the statue's name on a model in<ref name="WookieeCast">{{WookYouTube|P02EhCiYOtY|WookieeCast Episode 1: Video Game Development with Lily Mansfield|quote=What was it, on ''Force Commander''? One of the texture artists on one of the models managed to work his name on the fold of Luke's lighsuit or something.|old=1}}</ref> the [[2000]] game<ref name="Force Commander">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref> ''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''.<ref name="WookieeCast" />
